description: This file defines the SceneDelegate class for a SwiftUI-based iOS app. It manages scene lifecycle events, sets up the root view, and interacts with app state and environment objects. It also includes logic for requesting app review prompts.

classes.name: SceneDelegate
classes.description: Handles scene lifecycle events, initializes the app's main window with a SwiftUI root view, and interacts with app state and environment objects.

methods.name: scene(_:willConnectTo:options:)
methods.description: Configures the main window and root view, and triggers initial load actions.

methods.name: sceneDidDisconnect(_:)
methods.description: Saves app state when the scene disconnects.

methods.name: sceneWillResignActive(_:)
methods.description: Placeholder for handling scene resigning active state.

methods.name: sceneWillEnterForeground(_:)
methods.description: Prepares the scene to enter foreground and triggers app review request if applicable.
